overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board did not have to announce each remote participant's name at its February 22, 2021 meeting, following OML 2020-168 and OML 2021-44. The complaint was resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to announce the name of each member who participated remotely in its February 22, 2021 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: For substantially the same reasons stated in our recent determinations OML 2020-168 and OML 2021-44, copies of which are enclosed, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law as alleged.
